Test Case: Click a segment in the Analyze view
Expected Result: Segment becomes active with visible selection styling

Test Case: Click empty space outside all segments
Expected Result: Active segment is deselected

Test Case: Cmd/Ctrl-click to select multiple segments
Expected Result: All clicked segments show as selected

Test Case: Structure menu > Select All Segments
Expected Result: Every segment in the study is selected

Test Case: Structure menu > Select All Sections
Expected Result: Every section is selected

Test Case: Structure menu > Select All Columns
Expected Result: Every column is selected

Test Case: Structure menu > Select All Connections
Expected Result: Every connection is selected

Test Case: Click/drag to select a range of words inside a segment
Expected Result: Words highlight and word-dependent buttons (Split Segment / Move Text) enable

Test Case: Clear a word selection by clicking elsewhere
Expected Result: Selection clears and word-dependent buttons disable

Test Case: Select a word mid-segment and use Structure menu > Split Segment
Expected Result: Segment splits at the selection into two segments with correct text

Test Case: Verify Split Segment is disabled with no word selection
Expected Result: Menu item is disabled

Test Case: Activate a segment (not the first) and use Structure menu > Join Selected Up
Expected Result: Segment folds into the one ABOVE it and disappears; its text/note merge into that segment; selection clears

Test Case: Attempt Join Selected Up on the very first segment of the study
Expected Result: Menu item is disabled; if the study is part of a series with an ineligible previous seam a reason is shown beneath it

Test Case: Activate a segment (not the last) and use Structure menu > Join Selected Down
Expected Result: The segment BELOW folds into the activated one; the activated segment SURVIVES and stays selected; notes merge in word order

Test Case: Attempt Join Selected Down on the very last segment of the study
Expected Result: Join is refused with a message about nothing following; no structure changes

Test Case: Note the result of Join Down on segment N then undo by rebuilding; compare with Join Up on segment N+1
Expected Result: Both produce the same structure - same surviving segment and same merged content

Test Case: Select a SECTION (not a segment) and use Join Selected Up / Down
Expected Result: The whole SECTION is joined - not just a segment; the menu label stays Join Selected Up/Down

Test Case: Select a COLUMN and use Join Selected Up / Down
Expected Result: The whole COLUMN is joined; the menu label stays Join Selected Up/Down

Test Case: With nothing selected open the Structure menu
Expected Result: Join Selected Up and Join Selected Down are both disabled; labels are unchanged from when something is selected

Test Case: Trigger a Join Up and a Join Down that each discard content
Expected Result: Confirmation modal appears and its title names the direction (Join Segment Up vs Join Segment Down)

Test Case: Activate a segment and use Structure menu > Split Section
Expected Result: Section splits at the active segment into two sections

Test Case: Activate a segment and use Structure menu > Split Column
Expected Result: Column splits at that point; new column renders beside the original

Test Case: Verify Split Column disabled state
Expected Result: Item is disabled when a column cannot be inserted at the selection

Test Case: Select words and use Move Text Up
Expected Result: Selected text moves to the previous segment

Test Case: Select words and use Move Text Down
Expected Result: Selected text moves to the next segment

Test Case: Verify Move Text Up/Down disabled without word selection
Expected Result: Both items are disabled

Test Case: Perform split/join operations rapidly in succession
Expected Result: No corruption; structure stays consistent after each operation

Test Case: With an active segment apply Markup > Heading One
Expected Result: Heading editor appears; entered text renders as an H1-style heading

Test Case: Apply Heading Two and Heading Three to segments
Expected Result: Each heading level renders with distinct styling

Test Case: Edit an existing heading's text
Expected Result: Updated text saves and displays

Test Case: Delete a heading (click into heading then Delete toolbar button)
Expected Result: Heading is removed; segment remains intact

Test Case: Add/edit a passage-level heading
Expected Result: Heading persists and renders above the passage

Test Case: Navigate between segments using keyboard
Expected Result: Focus/active state moves as designed without trapping

Test Case: Perform structure edits then reload the page
Expected Result: All splits/joins/headings persist exactly

Test Case: Perform structure edits then open the study on the Document view
Expected Result: Document view reflects the current structure

Test Case: In a study with multiple passages perform structure edits in each
Expected Result: Edits apply only to the targeted passage

Test Case: With no segment active open the Structure menu
Expected Result: All segment/section/column operations are disabled

Test Case: Enable View > Outline View then try structure editing
Expected Result: Structure and Markup menus are disabled in outline/overview mode

Test Case: Enable Focus mode then check Layout and Connect menus
Expected Result: Layout and Connect menus are disabled while Focus is on
